verdict.rationale: Godot supports automated import via import plugins (EditorImportPlugin), batch-changing import parameters for multiple assets, EditorScript for running custom scripts in-editor, and CLI/headless mode enabling scripted pipeline invocation (godot --headless) for CI-driven imports. However, there's no evidence of a dedicated hook system triggered automatically on file add/change beyond the built-in resource importer, no first-party asset-pipeline automation framework, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of technical artists actually automating pipelines this way. missing for 10: documented automatic pre/post-import hook triggers, first-party pipeline scripting examples/tutorials, independent hands-on validation from technical artists using it for batch pipeline automation.
